topic: How are link budgets affected when prioritizing high-revenue services versus navigation safety margins in dynamic scheduling?
consensus_response: Link budget calculations are significantly impacted by frequency reuse and channel coding. Higher bandwidth demands of revenue-generating services increase interference, requiring techniques like TDD and OFDM for efficient resource utilization.  Improved channel coding enhances data transmission efficiency, optimizing link budgets while maintaining QoS guarantees. Dynamic scheduling balances these priorities by prioritizing high-revenue services with careful planning to avoid detrimental impacts on navigation safety margins.
